allowed_actions: read fresh Legacy ledger, duplication map and negative knowledge before ideation
research one bounded causal market mechanism from admissible public evidence
map payer or forced actor, causal chain, expression, confounders and falsification
persist at most one frozen CandidateHypothesis and exactly one VALIDATION handoff, or persist NO_CANDIDATE

inputs.objective: Find exactly one causally distinct quantitative/market-mechanism candidate from admissible public documentary or literature evidence, screen Legacy before freeze, and freeze at most one CandidateHypothesis without inspecting candidate returns.

success_condition: One Legacy-screened, causally distinct quantitative/mechanism CandidateHypothesis is frozen and handed to independent validation, or a durable NO_CANDIDATE result is persisted.
